description: This file defines the `SectionPagesField` class, a component of the MigraDoc document object model that represents a field referencing the total number of pages in a section. It includes methods for serialization and cloning, and manages internal values specific to the section pages field.

classes.name: SectionPagesField
classes.description: Represents a field that references the total number of pages in the current section within a document.

classes.name: SectionPagesField.SectionPagesFieldValues
classes.description: Holds the internal nullable properties specific to the SectionPagesField.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with a parent DocumentObject.

methods.description: Creates a deep copy of this `SectionPagesField` instance.
